name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
benefit_summary: Direct income support of Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal installments of Rs. 2,000 every four months via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families across India (subject to institutional/income-tax exclusion criteria).
how_to_apply: Register online at pmkisan.gov.in, via the PM-KISAN mobile app, or at the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) / State Nodal Officer.

name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
benefit_summary: Comprehensive crop insurance covering pre-sowing prevented sowing, standing crop losses (drought, flood, hailstorm, pest/disease), and post-harvest losses for up to 14 days. Farmer premium capped at 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
how_to_apply: Enroll through pmfby.gov.in, CSC centres, bank branches, or Crop Insurance mobile app before the seasonal cut-off date.

name: KCC (Kisan Credit Card) & Modified Interest Subvention Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Finance & Ministry of Agriculture
benefit_summary: Timely short-term crop loans up to Rs. 3 lakh at 7% p.a., effectively 4% p.a. with 3% Prompt Repayment Incentive (PRI). Collateral-free limit up to Rs. 1.60 lakh (and enhanced limits for allied activities).
eligibility: Individual/joint farmers, owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, SHGs, JLGs, and animal husbandry/fisheries farmers.
how_to_apply: Apply at any Commercial Bank, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), Cooperative Bank, or via PM-KISAN KCC saturation portal.

name: Soil Health Card (SHC) Scheme
benefit_summary: Free soil testing of 12 parameters (N, P, K, S, pH, EC, OC, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, B) with crop-wise fertilizer & micronutrient recommendations every 2 years to cut excess Urea/DAP cost.
how_to_apply: Submit soil samples via Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK), State Soil Testing Labs, or download cards at soilhealth.dac.gov.in.

name: e-NAM (Electronic National Agriculture Market)
benefit_summary: Pan-India electronic trading portal networking APMC mandis for transparent online bidding, quality assaying, real-time mandi prices, and direct bank settlement.
eligibility: Any farmer selling agricultural produce at integrated APMC mandis.
how_to_apply: Register free at enam.gov.in, via the e-NAM mobile app, or at the mandi entry gate.

name: PMKSY — Per Drop More Crop (Micro-Irrigation)
benefit_summary: Financial assistance of 55% for Small & Marginal farmers and 45% for other farmers (with additional state top-ups up to 75-90%) for installing Drip and Sprinkler irrigation systems.
eligibility: Farmers with cultivable land and a reliable water source.
how_to_apply: Apply through your State Agriculture/Horticulture DBT portal (e.g., RajKisan Sathi, MahaDBT, UP Agriculture).

name: PKVY (Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana)
benefit_summary: Promotes cluster-based organic farming with financial assistance of Rs. 31,500 per hectare over 3 years (including DBT for organic inputs, PGS-India certification, and marketing support).
eligibility: Farmer clusters (minimum 20 hectares / 20+ farmers) adopting organic farming practices.
how_to_apply: Contact local District Agriculture Officer, KVK, or register on pgsindia-ncof.gov.in.

name: PM-KUSUM (Solar Agriculture Pumps & Grid-Connected Solar)
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
benefit_summary: Up to 60% combined Central + State subsidy (30% Central + 30% State; higher in NE/hilly states) plus 30% bank loan for standalone solar water pumps (2 HP to 10 HP) and solarizing existing grid pumps.
eligibility: Individual farmers, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), cooperatives, and panchayats.
how_to_apply: Apply only through the official State Nodal Agency portal listed on pmkusum.mnre.gov.in.

name: SMAM (Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization & Kisan Drones)
benefit_summary: 40% to 50% subsidy for individual farmers on tractors, rotavators, seed drills, and up to 50% (max Rs. 5 lakh) for SC/ST/Small/Marginal/Women farmers and 75-80% for FPOs/CHCs on Kisan Agricultural Drones.
eligibility: Individual farmers, Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs), FPOs, and rural entrepreneurs.
how_to_apply: Apply online at agrimachinery.nic.in or State DBT farm mechanization portal.

name: AIF (Agriculture Infrastructure Fund)
benefit_summary: Medium-to-long-term debt financing up to Rs. 2 crore with 3% interest subvention for up to 7 years and CGTMSE credit guarantee for warehouses, cold storages, grading units, and primary processing.
eligibility: Farmers, FPOs, PACS, agri-entrepreneurs, startups, and state agencies.
